about: An ordered list of links from the site root to the current page.

collapsed.about: A trail with the crumbs between the first crumb and the current page replaced by an ellipsis. The ellipsis takes an aria-label with the number of crumbs it replaces, so a screen reader announces the full depth.
collapsed.title: Collapsed

label: Breadcrumb

size.about: Every size, one trail per row. The size sets the text style and the gap between crumbs.
size.title: Sizes

title: Breadcrumb

variant.about: Both looks. The current page is a span in the default ink, and the links above it are muted.
variant.title: Looks
